name: convhull
expr: K = convhull(x, y); nK = numel(K); a = polyarea(x(K), y(K));
comment: Sig: K = convhull(x, y). Convex-hull vertex indices (1-based, CCW, first repeated last) of 4 square corners + 1 interior point. nK=5 (interior pt 5 excluded), K=[1 2 3 4 1] (matches MATLAB R2025b monotone-chain order), hull area a=1 (order-invariant guard). Lifted to public C++ API numkit::builtin::convhull (was adapter-only) 2026-06; MATLAB's 2nd 'v' (area) output is a v1 gap.
